Battle Arena Toshinden Boss Roster

Default: disabled. Enable on the launcher's Mods page.

This package adds Gaia and Sho as optional visible choices on the character
select screen. The normal eight-character roster is unchanged. Press Up or Down
from the regular roster to move that player into the central boss column, press
Up or Down again to return to the regular roster, and press Left or Right while
in the boss column to choose Gaia or Sho. Confirm uses the game's normal
selection and match-load path.

The visible boss cards and large portraits are supplied by title-specific UI
integration. The portrait textures are generated mod artwork, not extracted or
redistributed game assets; source details are documented in
assets/mods/boss-roster/SOURCE.md.
